firstLines: Marketing coordinator with three years of experience running email and social campaigns for a regional
health network and a retail brand. Comfortable with HubSpot, Google Analytics and Excel, and used to
turning campaign results into short reports for managers.
• Plan and send 10 to 12 patient email campaigns a month in HubSpot; average open rate rose from
• Built a monthly Looker Studio report on appointment requests that the director uses in budget
• Coordinate print and social assets for 14 clinic locations with two designers and an outside print
• Wrote the team's first email style guide, which cut review rounds per campaign from three to one
• Scheduled Instagram and Facebook posts for three store openings; followers grew from 4,800 to
• Tracked weekly promo results in Excel and flagged two coupon codes that were losing money
• Wrote product descriptions for about 150 items when the online store launched in 2022
• Helped about 80 customers a shift and trained five new hires on the register and returns process
• Built the weekly endcap displays for seasonal items, which the store manager used as the model for
Bachelor of Arts in Communication May 2021
